resources.string: Press FN on its own to get to the home screen from anywhere, even from a game. The home screen is Daijishou, where your games and apps are.\n\nThis works once the setup is finished, so there\'s nothing to try here yet.

Hold FN and press Y to open your notifications and the Quick Settings, with tiles for things like Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. FN + Y again closes them.\n\nThis works once the setup is finished, so there\'s nothing to try here yet.
